In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)=sin⁡x$ and $v(x)={x}^{2}.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{(sin⁡x)^{′}\cdot {x}^{2}-sin⁡x\cdot ({x}^{2})^{′}}{({x}^{2})^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{x}^{2}cos⁡x-2xsin⁡x}{{x}^{4}} \\  & =\frac{x(xcos⁡x-2sin⁡x)}{{x}^{4}} \\  & =\frac{xcos⁡x-2sin⁡x}{{x}^{3}}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
